issue.title: Orphaned sase_artifact skill (Jul 3 deployment) documents -n labels and move-by-default, contradicting sase artifact create

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by sase-1m3.7.1.5 note #5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and filed by the sase-1m3.7.1 land agent.

An orphaned, stale `sase_artifact` skill is still deployed and offered to agents. Copies sit at `~/.claude/skills/sase_artifact/SKILL.md`, `~/.codex/skills/sase_artifact/SKILL.md` and `~/.gemini/skills/sase_artifact/SKILL.md`. All three are plain files dated 2026-07-03, and Claude sessions still list the skill ("Create explicit SASE artifacts from files produced during an agent run.").

What is wrong with it:
- It tells agents to run `sase artifact create -p <path> -n "<label>"` and says `-n, --label` sets the display name. The current CLI uses `-l/--label`.
- It says create *moves* the file into artifact storage. The current CLI copies by default; `-m/--move` is opt-in.
- The audited `sase_artifacts.md` memory note documents the current behavior.

Root cause: no source template for it exists in `src/sase/macros/skills/`. Commit a1da80ddb2 moved artifact guidance into the generated `sase_artifacts.md` memory and retired the `sase_artifact_file` skill. The older `sase_artifact` name was never added to the retired-target pruning list (see closed sase-cr). As a result, `sase skill list` does not show it at all, and `sase skill init --force` never removes it.

Proposed change: add `sase_artifact` to the retired generated-skill names so `sase skill init --force` prunes all provider targets. If pruning cannot reach these unmanaged files, remove them with the owner's approval. Do not resurrect the skill: `sase_artifacts.md` plus the `sase artifact` CLI is the supported path.

issue.creation_reason: Agents are still offered a stale, orphaned sase_artifact skill whose flags and move semantics contradict the current CLI; proposed by sase-1m3.7.1.5 and not tracked anywhere.

Prior artifact memory drift fix; sase_artifacts.md is the supported replacement
